engine: AIR T-422 giant number-fact + T-304 count-up: one HUGE number (clamp ~20-28vw of the viewport, default clamp(72px, 21vw, 360px)) with a small uppercase unit on its baseline and a human label underneath. When the section enters the viewport (ScrollTrigger once:true at 'top 78%'), the block slides in (translateY + opacity, transform-only) while a proxy tween counts the number from 0 to its value on the inlined house ease (D13). ONE SHOT: scrolling away and back never re-runs it. D6 counter law: onUpdate writes textContent ONLY when the formatted string CHANGED; stats { ticks, writes } are exposed so the lab machine-proves writes < ticks. Number format = the copy canon: thousands grouped with a non-breaking space (22 800), decimals with a comma (1,5); real characters in JS strings, never HTML entities (B16/K7). tabular-nums kills digit jitter during the count; negative tracking on the big body (C27). The markup carries the FINAL formatted number, so no-JS / reduced-motion / no-GSAP shows the truth with zero scripts.

measured_teardown.move: markup-first: [data-gnf] hosts [data-gnf-num data-gnf-value data-gnf-decimals] + [data-gnf-unit] + [data-gnf-label]. wire: number reset to format(0), host hidden (y = slidePx, opacity 0). onEnter (once): two tweens - the host slides to y:0 / opacity 1 (duration capped at 1.1s) and the proxy counts value over `duration` seconds; both on the same inlined house ease. onUpdate ticks++ and writes textContent only on a format change (writes++). onComplete forces the exact final formatted string.
measured_teardown.cited: AIR lifestyle slides: 400 STORES, 3 MIN WALK set in a huge grade over human photos (T-422); EVR extends the same move with a count-up divider (T-321 = T-304 + T-422). Mobile note from the AIR mobile teardown: a ROW of desktop number-facts becomes the T-M18 frosted swipe strip - that translation belongs to the SECTION/combo, the atom itself stays a single giant fact and simply scales down (the unit wraps under the number on narrow screens).

value.what: the target number. Default = data-gnf-value from markup; NaN -> static branch (markup text stands as is).

decimals.what: decimal places; rendered with a comma (1,5) per the copy canon. Default = data-gnf-decimals | 0.

duration.what: count duration (house dur-3 = 1.6 slow reveal). The slide-in runs at min(duration, 1.1)s so the block always lands before the count settles.

ease.what: named house token ('air', 'out-quad', 'out-expo', 'linear') driving BOTH the slide and the count; inlined bezier solver (D13).

slidePx.what: entrance travel of the whole block (translateY only, D4).

start.what: ScrollTrigger start; the trigger is always once:true - the number arrives ONE time and stands.

trigger.what: 'scroll' = ScrollTrigger once-fire; 'manual' = no trigger, the integrator calls play() itself (combos that choreograph their own beat).

css_surface.--gnf-size: number font-size (default clamp(72px, 21vw, 360px) - the giant grade; C27 scale law asserts >= 18% vw in the lab)
css_surface.--gnf-tracking: number letter-spacing (default -0.03em - C27 negative tracking on big grades)
css_surface.--gnf-weight: number font-weight (default 300 - the AIR light grotesk)

entry: GiantNumberFact.create(target, opts) -> { el, num, value, stats, played, play(), refresh(), destroy(), ready }. target = the [data-gnf] element (or any element that itself carries data-gnf-num). stats = { ticks, writes } for the D6 machine probe; played flips true after the one-shot fires. GiantNumberFact.format(v, decimals) is exported for integrators that must render matching numbers.
law: motion = transform/opacity on the block + textContent of the counter only (D4/D6); zero CSS transition on driven props (D3); the counter writes the DOM ONLY on a value change - stats prove it; once:true, the number never re-counts on re-scroll; thousands = non-breaking space, decimals = comma, real characters never entities (B16/K7); tabular-nums + negative tracking on the giant grade (C27); the unit wraps under the number on narrow screens instead of clipping (flex-wrap); no getComputedStyle in the frame; no mix-blend / no backdrop / no WebGL; markup holds the final number = static truth without JS; the component NEVER sets __LAB_OK__ - the lab owns the gate (B14/B15).
gate_mode: scroll-driven one-shot. Lab (desktop pack): C27 scale - computed font-size >= 18% of viewport width, letter-spacing negative, tabular-nums on; DRIVE by real scroll - the section is scrolled into view and textContent sampled at 120/300/800ms: values rise monotonically and at 120ms the count has NOT yet settled; settled text EXACTLY equals the canon format ('22 800' with a non-breaking space); the block arrived (opacity 1, transform identity); the number bbox sits fully inside the viewport (a giant that clips off-screen is a failed giant); decimal instance settles EXACTLY at '1,5'; D6 instance (value 5): stats.writes <= 7 while stats.ticks > writes (the counter wrote the DOM only on change); ONCE - scroll away and back: ticks unchanged, text still final. MOBILE pack (<=768px): number fits (bbox.left >= 16px, right <= vw), count fired and settled at '22 800', the same D6 discipline, page <= 8 screens, no content gap > 1.5 screens, text Range-rects left >= 16px.
proven: lab.html v1: three canon facts between full-bleed render sections (C11, renders/ symlink) on a light/dark rhythm - 22 800 доларів (ET-09), 1,5 сотки (ET-29) as the decimal-comma proof on the dark act, 5 хвилин до Вінниці (ET-16) as the D6 write-discipline proof. Headless-measured at 1440x900: grade 302.4px = 21.0% vw with letter-spacing -9.07px and tabular-nums on; count samples 9602 -> 17241 -> 22485 at 120/300/800ms, settled EXACTLY '22 800' (non-breaking thousands space), block arrived (opacity 1, transform identity), bbox inside the viewport; decimal instance settled '1,5'; D6 instance (value 5): 66 ticks vs 6 DOM writes; once probe: 67 -> 67 ticks after scrolling away and back, text stands; 0 console errors. Mobile pack at 390x844: number fits (unit wraps under it), settled '22 800', D6 66/6, page 4.65 screens, max gap 0.65 screens, min text-rect left 23.4px. Both packs also green at 1280x720.
